doc: State files from the owner's playthrough that checks still read and no recipe makes yet (docs/ROADMAP.md 1.1). They exist on one machine only: a check on them SKIPs anywhere else. The list only shrinks -- tools/input_provenance.py (the check inputs-come-from-recipes-or-sources) fails on a check that reads a state file from none of recipe / third-party / this list, and on an entry here no check reads any more. Rewrite it with `python tools/input_provenance.py --write` after moving checks onto recipe-made twins.
